* Envoy Proxy \& xDS Control Plane (Service Connect) — At the core of our service mesh lies Envoy, a versatile, open\-source proxy deployed as a sidecar to intercept and manage east\-west traffic. * Elastic Load Balancing Integration (Service Gateway) — For north\-south ingress traffic, we orchestrate AWS Elastic Load Balancers (ALB \& NLB) on behalf of customers. * AWS Cloud Map (Service Discovery) — The foundational registry that powers service discovery across the stack.
